ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
(2015 · Hangzhou midterm) When Xiaoqiang was refueling at a gas station, he saw icons on the fuel dispenser as shown in Figure 19-18. Regarding the physical knowledge involved in the icons and its understanding, which of the following statements is correct:
A. The basis for making these icons is the principle of electrostatic shielding
B. Staff members must wear chemical-fiber clothing with good insulating properties during working hours
C. Chemical-fiber gloves easily become charged by friction with objects they contact, posing a safety hazard
D. Using an insulating plastic comb to comb one's hair should not matter
